messages:
izzy: Heads-up: sudden spike in gpu-attach failures in eu-north1 (~22%) tied to a rare "ephemeral-genlock" pattern on a few hosts. Seeing long blk_mq stalls and nvme resets. anyone on call?

izzy: dmesg from gn-north-21:
```
[ 9012.345678] blk_mq_dispatch: queue 0 stuck, inflight 144
[ 9012.345890] nvme nvme0: I/O 7 timed out, aborting
[ 9012.346100] nvme0n1: end_request: I/O error, dev 259:1, sector 234567
[ 9012.346500] nvme nvme0: controller reset due to error
```

phil: yep saw similar on gn-north-20 and gn-north-23. Pattern: massive smallwrite serialization when ephemeral-genlock holds a single write token per-device while janitor/overlay checkpoint try to drain. Genlock serializes many writers and pushes queue depth spikes.

arthur: that genlock mechanism was added to avoid concurrent journal races, but under our current janitor concurrency it becomes a hot checkpoint bottleneck.

mei: mitigation plan (short): 1) reduce janitor/checkpoint concurrency to 1 for eu-north1, 2) temporarily disable genlock on affected hosts (flip feature flag), 3) cordon the worst hosts and route attaches away.

phil: commands I'm running now:
```
# cordon hosts
kubectl cordon gn-north-20 gn-north-21
kubectl drain gn-north-20 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
# flip feature flag for genlock on the region via configmap
kubectl -n ops patch configmap runtime-flags --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/ephemeral_genlock_enabled_eu-north1","value":"false"}]'
```

ops-bot: Router policy updated: attach-routing (eu-north1 hotlist) -> eu-west2 (canary, 60m).

arthur: also lowering vm.dirty_ratio on these hosts to smooth writeback bursts: `sysctl -w vm.dirty_ratio=5 vm.dirty_background_ratio=2` applied via fleet-script.

mei: immediate health checks: schedule SMART quick and run non-destructive badblocks. If reallocated sectors >3% OR reset_count >8 in 24h, flag for replacement.

phil: vendor note: if genlock flips consistently correlate with firmware timeouts, we may need a firmware update; opening ticket with vendor + attaching kernel logs.

izzy: opened INC-5137 to track: summary, mitigation steps, config changes, SMART + vendor ticket. tagging storage-team.

arthur: post-mitigation follow-ups: 1) reconsider genlock semantics (allow per-queue tokens instead of global per-device), 2) add jitter to janitor checkpoint start times to avoid synchronized waves, 3) implement autoscaling safety to keep 4% hot spare per region for attach storms.

mei: cost callout: keeping 4% hot spare in eu regions is cheaper than repeated attach retries and emergency replacements. Recommend temporary budget reallocation.

phil: ops-runbook change: add detection rule for "genlock backpressure": if attach-failure-rate >10% and >2 hosts show blk_mq queue stalls in 10m, auto-throttle janitor and flip ephemeral_genlock flag for that region, plus attach-router fallback. PR incoming.

izzy: current status: cordoned 2/5 hosts, genlock feature-flag flipped, janitor concurrency reduced, routing fallback live. Attach error rate down to ~6%. Leaving thread open for SMART & vendor response. :white_check_mark:
